title: Fat Bottom Trivia Host T-shirt
shortDescription: The house shirt for trivia hosts, with free shipping anywhere in the USA and Canada.
description:
The shirt our own hosts wear behind the mic. Turn up in it and the room knows who is running the night before you say a word.

Ships free anywhere in the USA and Canada. After checkout you will get an order confirmation by email, and we will be in touch about sizing before it goes out.

Questions about fit, or want a batch for the whole crew? Contact us and we will sort it out.

title: Triv 101 Premium — Full Question Bank
shortDescription: Unlocks the complete Triv 101 bank of 1,350 survey-style questions, with instant access.
description:
Triv 101 is our host-run survey trivia game. Every team starts at 101 points, guesses the most popular survey answers, presses their luck, and races down to exactly zero. It runs in a browser on a single screen, so there is nothing to install and nothing to print.

Premium unlocks the full question bank: 1,350 survey-style questions in total, which is enough to host week after week without recycling the same prompts.

Access is instant after checkout. Try the free version first if you want to see the format before you upgrade.

title: The Wild West — Big Screen Trivia Show
shortDescription: A western-themed game show with five categories, three hidden side-games and a final challenge.
description:
A full night of trivia built for a projector or a big TV. Five clickable categories — The Mild West, A Country Tune, Folk Heroes, Name That Cowboy and "Hats" Off To You — plus three hidden side-games and a final challenge to settle it.

Family friendly, tested on a real audience, and pitched at 3 out of 5 for difficulty, so a mixed room stays in it.

Delivered as a .ppsx slideshow, which means you will need Microsoft PowerPoint or an equivalent and a screen the whole room can see. Download it, open it in presenter mode, and host.

title: Sports Pub Night — "The Olympics" Trivia Show
shortDescription: An Olympics-themed sports trivia game show for the big screen, with a Toss Off finale.
description:
Sports trivia for a room that actually watches the games. The categories are built around the Olympics, there are three hidden side-games along the way, and a "Toss Off" final challenge decides it.

This is a friendly place to start if you have never hosted before, and it plays well for a pub crowd rather than a room of specialists.

Delivered as a .ppsx slideshow for a projector or big TV, so you will need Microsoft PowerPoint or an equivalent. Immediate download, nothing ships, and the file is yours to run again.

title: The Host Handbook: Start a Successful Trivia Night
shortDescription: Our step-by-step guide to starting and running a trivia night. Sold on Amazon, not through this store.
description:
Everything we have learned about starting a trivia night, in one short read: the game rules, choosing the right venue and room, downloading and running episodes, setting up a big-screen game board, adding music to your shows, and making money while you are having fun. Plus a bonus section, "7 Top Tips For Booking More Shows."

The advice applies to any trivia night. The specific rules for Fat Bottom Trivia are in there too.

This title is sold through Amazon rather than our own checkout. Contact us if you would like a heads-up when it goes live.

title: 10,000+ Trivia Questions & Answers — Pack 1

A working question bank for hosts who need material on hand. Over 10,000 questions and answers in an Excel file, so you can search a keyword and pull what you need in seconds.

Use it to fill a round, build a themed set, keep tiebreakers in your back pocket, or run bonus questions when a game finishes early. It is not a formatted show — it is the raw supply you write your rounds from.

Instant download after checkout, yours to keep. Packs 2, 3 and 4 are separate files if you get through this one.

title: 10,000+ Trivia Questions & Answers — Pack 2

Hosts who run weekly go through material fast. This is what you reach for once Pack 1 has already been in front of your regulars.

Good for stocking up on tiebreakers, covering a theme night, or handing a stack of bonus questions to a co-host. Instant download, nothing ships, and it is yours to reuse for every night you run.

title: 13,000+ Trivia Questions & Answers — Pack 4
